Mara (CS): Starting a follow-up thread for the latency spike. We need: short public status copy, an enterprise-facing note (SLA impact + next steps), owners for remediation, and a clear RCA-sharing workflow. Volunteers?

Diego (SRE): I'll own the immediate fixes. Plan: emergency scaling rule adjustment rolled in 24h, full fix (backpressure + integration tests) in 11 days. Filing ticket INC-5042.

Yara (PM): This matches two previous spikes this year. I'll run the retro and own recurring-incident actions (tests, runbook changes).

Quinn (Comms): Draft status page copy (suggested):
"09:14-09:42 UTC — Increased latency impacted some API requests. A mitigation was applied and we're monitoring. Short summary within 24h; a full RCA within 5 business days. Affected customers can contact support@redwood.ai."

Ivy (Security): Policy note: public summary is fine. Redacted RCA available on request to affected customers after Security review. Full operational logs/diagrams require Legal + NDA if a customer requests raw artifacts.

tracker-bot: Created INC-5042 https://tracker.redwood.ai/INC-5042

Diego (SRE): Action items (w/ owners and due dates):
- Diego: emergency scaling roll  due 2026-09-02
- Diego: durable fix + tests  due 2026-09-13
- Yara: retro + recurring-incident doc  due 2026-09-06
- Quinn: statuspage short copy + publish  due 2026-09-01 (24h)
- Mara + Sales: enterprise private note template  due 2026-09-02
- Ivy: redaction checklist & sign-off flow  due 2026-09-04

Yara (PM): Retro scheduled Friday 10:00 PST. Invite SRE, infra-test, CS, Comms, Security, Sales.

Mara (CS): I'll gather affected accounts and attach to INC-5042, then coordinate customer outreach once Comm copy is live.

Quinn (Comms): One more editorial note: keep public language non-technical; include SLA math only in private enterprise note. I'll post the short status copy to the page after review.

Diego (SRE): I'll also add a dashboard alarm for queue-depth growth and a 90th-percentile latency watch to help detect recurrence. ETA for alerts: 4 days.

Mara (CS): Thanks team — owners above. Please update INC-5042 as tasks progress and tag this thread when done.
